title: BTWR: Resource Data
description: Mandatory resource pack for the "Better Than Wolves: Remastered!" modpack
body:
This resource pack changes some assets related to vanilla minecraft & mods that are included in the "Better Than Wolves: Remastered!" modpack.

---

**Some of the changes include:**


Blockstate definitions

Block & Item models

Block & Item textures

Translatable text (Item & block names, subtitles, etc...)

---
Disclaimer:

**It is meant to be used only with the "Better than Wolves: Remastered!" modpack**
